scope: Seventeen downloaded photographs/object photographs. Copyright provenance and capture dates checked against file pages. Not a release approval of the finished documentary.
global_usage_notes: Use the visible date_label with historical scenes; product introduction date and photograph date are not interchangeable.
Attribution, source links, license links, and modification notices must travel with the distributed film/assets. Public-domain/CC0 credits are retained for provenance.

CC BY-SA photographs require the applicable ShareAlike conditions for distributed adaptations. Do not put an unqualified all-rights-reserved claim over these assets. The final project must resolve its actual use and notices; this manifest does not declare the entire film or source code CC BY-SA.
Copyright licenses do not imply endorsement or remove personality/trademark rights. Logos are present as documentary content only.
No AI-created historical photograph, face animation, synthetic period image, or locally altered photo is included.
Modern architecture and portraits cannot stand in silently for the founding period. The one 1989 factory archive depicts Erfurt in East Germany, not TSMC.
Both photographed RIVA 128 and RIVA 128ZX packages visibly carry ST marks. Do not label the 128ZX photo as a proven TSMC-manufactured unit.
Download/decoding/hash verification is complete. Film integration, crop readability, caption persistence, and runtime link checks remain the root agent's responsibility.

historical_primary_sources.supports: ST primary manufacturer, TSMC additional manufacturer, and ST's 128ZX manufacturing/sales rights; relationship facts are not inferred from photographed samples
TSMC's 2002 retrospective corporate statement of NVIDIA collaboration beginning in 1998
